Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ReleaseInventoryInterphaseHeatTransfer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ReleaseInventoryInterphaseHeatTransfer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReleaseInventoryInterphaseHeatTransfer extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, provenance-required interfacial heat-transfer closure for a gas/liquid release inventory.

The linear model uses Qdot_gas = UA * (T_liquid - T_gas). Positive heat therefore enters the gas and the same energy leaves the liquid. The conductance is a prescribed sensitivity input: this class does not infer a correlation, wall contribution, boiling heat transfer, droplet area or engineering applicability.
